document.description: US permanent residence document privileges verified against destination government sources

unlocks.conditions: Document proving permanent residence in the United States; visit for tourism, business or other activities without remuneration in Mexico
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Valid passport or identity and travel document. Present proof of US permanent residence. Immigration authorities may request the purpose of travel, itinerary, accommodation, funds and return or onward travel evidence.

source.verificationPath: INM > Paises y regiones que requieren visa para viajar a Mexico > alternative documents > item a) permanent residence

unlocks.notes: Visa exemption for visitors without permission to perform remunerated activities. The INM page states a maximum of 180 days; the authorized stay and admission are determined by the immigration authority. This entry concerns permanent residence, separately from the valid-visa exemption in item b).

unlocks.conditions: Valid US permanent residence permit and a national passport; visa-free entry, transit and stay for up to 90 days during a six-month period, within the validity of the residence permit
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Present the valid national passport together with the US permanent resident card. The exemption covers national passports and excludes emergency travel documents and travel documents issued under international conventions.

source.verificationPath: Ministry of Foreign Affairs > Citizens > Travel to Serbia > Visa Requirements > opening paragraphs on the decision of 30 October 2014
source.exactQuote: and for holders of foreign national passports having residence permit in the countries of the Schengen area, EU or the United States of America.

unlocks.notes: The opening paragraphs specify the residence-permit exemption, the 90-day limit during a six-month period, and the requirement to present a valid passport when the residence permit is a separate card. The residence permit must remain valid for the stay.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US permanent residence permit and valid foreign travel document; visa-free entry, transit and stay for up to 30 days, limited to the remaining validity of the residence permit
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Present a valid travel document and the valid US permanent resident card. The travel document must have been issued within the last ten years and normally remain valid for at least three months after the planned departure.

source.verificationPath: Government of Montenegro > Visas > visa-regime bullet for foreign residence permits, followed by Validity of travel documents
source.exactQuote: can enter, transit through the territory and stay in Montenegro for up to 30 days

unlocks.notes: The residence-permit bullet names the United States of America. If the residence permit expires within 30 days, the authorized stay under this exemption ends by its expiry. The source lists foreign residence permits separately from foreign visas.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US permanent residence permit; visa-free short visits for up to 90 days within a 180-day period
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Present a valid passport and the valid US permanent resident card. The Albanian embassy lists a valid US residence permit as a separate qualifying document; prior use is a condition attached to the US visa route.

source.verificationPath: Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs > VISA APPLICATION > visa-exemption table, item 2; Description gives the 90-days-in-180 short-stay period

unlocks.conditions: Citizens of countries subject to a Bosnian visa requirement may enter with a valid passport and US permanent residence permit; each uninterrupted stay is limited to 30 days, with a total of up to 90 days in any 180-day period and within the residence permit's validity

unlocks.conditions: Valid US Permanent Residence Card; visa exemption for visits of 30 days or less.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US residence document; tourism visa exemption with an initial stay of 30 days.
